Keringanan Iuran JKK diberikan sebesar 50% (lima puluh persen), sehingga Iuran JKK untuk setiap kelompok tingkat risiko lingkungan kerja menjadi:

output.reason: Employer-paid JKK premiums count as part of a permanent employee's gross income for PPh 21. This regulation cuts the JKK contribution by 50% for every risk tier (e.g. 0.24% to 0.12%, 1.74% to 0.87% of monthly wages). That lowers the JKK benefit added to gross income, but only for certain labour-intensive industries with at least 50 active BPJS participants. It applies to JKK contributions for February 2025 through July 2025. Part of the reduced JKK is also recomposed into JKP, which does not enter gross income.
